title: Global scalar-compatible free coordinates with independent integral ranks
statement: Fix a prime $l$, a finite-dimensional totally disconnected normed $\mathbf Q_l$-extension $E$, and $A=\operatorname{continuousIntegers}(l,E)$ [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Let $p:U\to X$, $g:Y\to X$, $t_j:Y\to U$ for $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(d)$ satisfy $t_jp=g$. Let $P$ be an internal continuous $E$-module on $X$, $M$ an internal continuous $A$-module on $U$, and $e:\operatorname{Ext}(M)\cong p^*P$. Suppose $g^*P$ and all $t_j^*M$ are globally finite free. There exist a rational rank $r$, independent integral ranks $n_j$, continuous-function presentations [def-sfb-continuous-function-module-presentation] $c$ of $\operatorname{Res}(g^*P)$ by $E^r$ and $b_j$ of $t_j^*M$ by $A^{n_j}$, and $C(B,E)$-linear equivalences $F_{j,B}:C(B,E^{n_j})\cong C(B,E^r)$ natural in every pro-etale $B/Y$. For every section $x$, $c(f_j(x))=F_{j,B}(\operatorname{incl}(b_j(x)))$, where $f_j$ is the actual normalized sheet map [def-sfb-finite-etale-lattice-sheet-maps]. No equality of ranks, matrices, invertibility of a pointwise matrix, or open-restriction assertion is included.

proof.text: Choose the finite free rational frame of rank r and each integral frame of its own rank n_j. Extend the integral frame by scalars. The regular-module scalar-extension isomorphism and its unit equation identify extension of the finite biproduct with the rational finite free object of rank n_j.

Use pullIso on t_j, then the pullback of e and upperStarComp, to identify this rationalized integral module with g*P. The inverse restriction/pullback comparison is the mate of the restriction/pushforward comparison; thus the adjoint of this rational isomorphism is exactly finiteEtaleLatticeSheetEmbedding, including its specified target normalization.

Encode the rational and integral finite free frames by finite products of continuous coefficient functions, using continuousRingFreeIso and the scalar-restriction comparison. The rational frame comparisons give the natural E-linear equivalences F on every test object. The unit equation from the first step identifies the integral-coordinate inclusion with the scalar-extension unit, so the normalized map of the second step gives the stated global equation. No ranks are identified and no point or open restriction is used.

theorem continuousFreeSheet_globalCoordinates
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    [TotallyDisconnectedSpace E] {X U Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (p : U ⟶ X)
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff l E) U))
    (e : (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap l E) U)).obj M ≅
      (upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P)
    (g : Y ⟶ X) (d : ℕ) (t : Fin d → (Y ⟶ U)) (w : ∀ j, t j ≫ p = g)
    (hP : Mod.IsFree (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) Y)
      ((upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) g).obj P))
    (hM : ∀ j, Mod.IsFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff l E) Y)
      ((upperStar (integralCoeff l E) (t j)).obj M)) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (n : Fin d → ℕ) (c : ContinuousFunctionPresentation Y (continuousIntegers l E)
        (Fin r → E) ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap l E) Y)).obj
          ((upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) g).obj P)))
      (b : ∀ j, ContinuousFunctionPresentation Y (continuousIntegers l E)
        (Fin (n j) → continuousIntegers l E) ((upperStar (integralCoeff l E) (t j)).obj M))
      (F : ∀ (j : Fin d) (B : Y.ProEt),
        C(B.left, Fin (n j) → E) ≃ₗ[C(B.left, E)] C(B.left, Fin r → E)),
      (∀ (j : Fin d) (B D : Y.ProEt) (a : D ⟶ B) (x : C(B.left, Fin (n j) → E)),
        F j D (x.comp a.left.base.hom) = (F j B x).comp a.left.base.hom) ∧
      ∀ (j : Fin d) (B : Y.ProEt)
        (x : ((continuousRingModuleEquivalence Y (continuousIntegers l E)).functor.obj
          ((upperStar (integralCoeff l E) (t j)).obj M)).val.obj (op B)),
        c.sections B
          (((continuousRingModuleEquivalence Y (continuousIntegers l E)).functor.map
            (finiteEtaleLatticeSheetEmbedding (integralScalarMap l E) P p M e
              g (t j) (w j))).val.app (op B) x) =
          F j B (continuousIntegralVector (continuousIntegers l E) ((b j).sections B x))
